_comment: Tier-2: max_iteration is a POSITIONAL constructor argument of ResidualBasedNewtonRaphsonStrategy, not a field on the ResidualCriteria. Pitfall (kratos.linear_elasticity #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The eight-argument constructor carrying max_iteration=30 builds; the four-argument call without it raises TypeError '__init__(): incompatible constructor arguments', so the value cannot be omitted and defaulted. And ResidualCriteria(1e-6, 1e-9) has no max_iteration attribute at all — the place the claim warns readers not to look for it really has nothing there. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
